title: Editor E0 task 12b, mount slice: the node layout store mounts in the app shell, light and subject-aware
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19. EntityLayoutMount wraps its children in NodeLayoutMount (a wrapper in node-layout-store.tsx) at the same position, always, so the shell does not remount. node-layout-store.tsx imports types only from the node modules and resets in place on a subject change, flushing the outgoing edit to the outgoing subject. Node saves go to saveSpaceGridLayout on a Space route. Honest gap: nothing reads the store yet, and the shell-weight result needs a production build (Mac session) because CI never builds.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const s=fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/node-layout-store.tsx','utf8');if(/from '@\/lib\/entity-blocks\/node-ops'/.test(s))bad.push('store imports node-ops at runtime (shell weight)');if(!/import type \{ NodeLayout \}/.test(s))bad.push('store lost its type-only import');const m=fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/profile-layout-context.tsx','utf8');if(!m.includes('<NodeLayoutMount'))bad.push('mount does not wrap in NodeLayoutMount');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1005: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the store regains a runtime node-ops import or the mount stops wrapping it. Behavior is node-layout-store.test.tsx and entity-layout-mount.test.tsx.
